description: Header file defining constants, types, inline functions, and macros for audio resampling and timestretching in Android's media framework.

methods.name: isAudioPlaybackRateEqual
methods.description: Checks if two AudioPlaybackRate instances are approximately equal based on speed, pitch, stretch mode, and fallback mode.

methods.name: isAudioPlaybackRateValid
methods.description: Validates if an AudioPlaybackRate instance has parameters within acceptable ranges, considering fallback and stretch modes.

methods.name: sourceFramesNeeded
methods.description: Calculates the maximum source frames needed to produce a given number of destination frames after resampling.

methods.name: destinationFramesPossible
methods.description: Estimates the upper bound of destination frames obtainable from source frames after sample rate conversion.

methods.name: sourceFramesNeededWithTimestretch
methods.description: Calculates source frames needed considering timestretch speed factor.

methods.name: isMusicRate
methods.description: Determines if a sample rate is associated with music, suitable for better resampling.
